mapper.select: select slot_code, page_code, name, kind, min_items, max_items, group_adjacent, rules, site_layout_page, sort_no, status from dashboard_view_slot order by page_code, sort_no, slot_code
select slot_code, item_code, item_name, group_code, group_name, sort_no, default_sort, status from dashboard_view_slot_item order by slot_code, sort_no, item_code
select slot_code, preset_code, name, tip, items, is_default, sort_no from dashboard_view_preset order by slot_code, sort_no, preset_code

select (select count(*) || '/' || coalesce(max(update_time)::text, '') from dashboard_view_slot) || '|' || (select count(*) || '/' || coalesce(max(update_time)::text, '') from dashboard_view_slot_item) || '|' || (select count(*) || '/' || coalesce(max(update_time)::text, '') from dashboard_view_preset)
mapper.sql: select id, user_id, site_code, slot_code, mode, preset_code, items, last_custom, attrs, update_time from dashboard_user_view
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} and site_code = #{siteCode} and slot_code = #{slotCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_user_view (user_id, site_code, slot_code, mode, preset_code, items, last_custom, attrs, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{siteCode}, #{slotCode}, #{mode}, #{presetCode}, #{items}, #{lastCustom}, #{attrs}, localtimestamp) on conflict (user_id, site_code, slot_code) do update set mode = excluded.mode, preset_code = excluded.preset_code, items = excluded.items, last_custom = excluded.last_custom, attrs = excluded.attrs, update_time = localtimestamp
mapper.delete: delete from dashboard_user_view where user_id = #{userId} and site_code = #{siteCode} and slot_code = #{slotCode}
